announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.5.0 hadir dengan MODE CERITA: satu desain jadi seri foto ala majalah lengkap dengan model — keseharian, editorial, atau kampanye fashion. 14 model siap pakai, busana otomatis, gaya 80 brand, hijab, SURPRISE ME, dan 16 RESEP SIAP PAKAI (termasuk kantor): sekali klik, lalu GENERATE. Tombolnya di sebelah MODE DETAIL. Tidak muncul update otomatis? Unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.5.0 brings STORY MODE: one design becomes a magazine-style photo series with models — daily life, editorial or fashion campaign. 14 ready models, automatic outfits, the style of 80 brands, hijab, SURPRISE ME and 16 READY RECIPES (office included): one click, then GENERATE. The button sits next to DETAIL MODE. No automatic update prompt? Download it at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
